title: EpiGauge: a measurement instrument for class-I T-cell epitope immunogenicity prediction
description:
A benchmark and measurement instrument for class-I T-cell epitope immunogenicity prediction. Ships one specified estimator (pair-weighted within-allele AUROC with degeneracy guards that raise rather than return a plausible wrong number), a contamination census attached to every leaderboard row, and a measured resolution limit below which differences are not reportable.

Standard-library Python only, no third-party dependencies. Includes two scored benchmark arms, four further arms with no competitor columns, 102 regression fixtures, and the supplementary artifacts behind every published figure.
